148338.overview:
A clone of Atari arcade hit Breakout.

It was originally released in 1978 for the Interact computer, being one of the first games available for this system and later re-released for the Hector without the Breakthrough graphic screen. 

This version is different from the arcade hit as the display is horizontal instead of vertical. Wall is on right, player on left.

There are several options available, like fast/slow mode, short/big paddle, 1 or 2 players game, and how many lives you start with (5 or 6).
